comment: Migrate component styling from Griffel to Tailwind CSS + CSS Modules. Styles now ship as a per-package stylesheet exported at ./styles.css instead of being injected at runtime, so consumers must import it (the @fluentui/react-components umbrella re-exports it). The BEM static class names previously published on component internals are no longer rendered; the *ClassNames constants are retained and marked deprecated for compile compatibility, with the root entry remaining each component's public identity class.
